onboarding.yes-creating-an-account: Yes. Creating an account is free and you don't need a card to sign up. Students pay per lesson; tutors keep 80% of every one-to-one booking.
onboarding.only-after-your-tutor: Only after your tutor accepts your request. You then pay by card to confirm the lesson. If you don't pay in time, the booking simply expires and nothing is charged.
onboarding.university-students-teaching-: University students teaching courses they've already taken. Tutors who confirm a university email address get the Verified badge and appear first in search.
onboarding.through-stripe-to-your: Through Stripe, to your bank account, 48 hours after each completed lesson. You keep 80% of every one-to-one booking.
onboarding.already-have-an-account-2: Already have an account? Sign inHiring student talent? Business accounts are coming soon.
onboarding.add-your-subjects-and: Add your subjects and when you are available.
onboarding.typical-rates-1830hr-for: Typical rates: €18–30/hr for university-student tutors, €30–50/hr for graduates and exam specialists.
onboarding.add-your-grades-or: Add your grades or certificates. The names and grades appear on your tutor profile. The files you upload are never public: only signed-in students can open them, and you can limit that to students you approve.
onboarding.max-5mb-pdf-jpg: Max 5MB. PDF, JPG or PNG. Will appear on your public tutor profile.
onboarding.add-exact-course-codes: Add exact course codes you can help with, so students searching for their specific class — not just the general subject — can find you.
onboarding.your-grade-optional: <label for="courseGrade" class="form-label">Your grade (optional)</label><input type="text" class="form-input" id="courseGrade" maxlength="20" placeholder="e.g. 1.3">
onboarding.students-can-find-you: Students can find you by course name, code or professor. The course is listed under your university.
onboarding.select-as-many-as: Select as many as apply. You'll be able to block off specific days or hours anytime from your dashboard after signing up.
onboarding.at-least-10-characters: At least 10 characters, with upper- and lowercase letters, a number and a symbol

onboarding.so-tutors-can-see: So tutors can see where you study and which course you need help with.
onboarding.so-students-can-see: So students can see where you studied. Confirm a university email later to get the Verified badge and appear first in search.
